Data changelog

Material changes to this release, with remaining gaps visible.

October 4, 2026 — prepared release

  • Expanded phone records with per-field sources and confidence, downloadable 3D views, and separate size-comparison controls. Unknown fields remain null.
  • Added the exact MSI PCI_E2/M2_3 sharing rule and CPU-group restriction to a dedicated checker.
  • Added seven explicit-input calculators and their method notes.
  • Added a reproducible catalog-coverage report with version 78beea7a8d2d.
  • Added source-intake review gates and a two-day news-sitemap policy. No unverified source item is published automatically.

Outstanding verification

Exact phone-support anchors, regional model codes, hands-on battery/camera results, all inherited specification fields and many exact product photographs remain unverified. 3D fit certification is a separate unresolved task. This release does not close those gaps by relabeling them.

Check dates identify research work; they are not proof that a release is live. Confirmed publication timestamps will be recorded when hosting deployment is verified.
